summary: Rabbi Tawil discusses why the first Misva given to the Jewish people in Parashat Bo, before Makkat Bechorot, is Kiddush Hahodesh. He explains how Rosh Hodesh and the Jewish calendar symbolize the gift of time given to free people. He also talks about utilizing vacation to reflect on prioritizing time for family, Torah, Misvot, and prayer.
subjects: The Greek attack on the Jewish calendar
questions: Why was Kiddush Hahodesh the first Misva given to the Jewish people in Egypt?
Why did the Greeks target the Jewish calendar?
How can vacation time help us reflect on how we spend our time?
